subject: Request: Technical demo – Docs quickstart
messages:
From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Technical demo – Docs quickstart

Hi Marissa,

I clicked through the docs/quickstart CTA and our team (platform + infra) is interested in a technical demo of Redwood Inference focused on private deployment and inference cost optimizations. We're a small infra team (2 engs) supporting a data-platform product that runs customer data pipelines; security and on-prem options are important for us.

High-level asks:
- Deep dive on Private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) and KMS integrations
- Example throughput/cost for a 3-node GPU footprint and quantization tradeoffs
- Networking and auth patterns for our env

Available windows next week (PDT): Tue 4/6 after 10am, Wed 4/7 1–3pm. Happy to book via Calendly if that's easier.

Thanks – Evan
Evan Liu
Senior Platform Engineer, Acme Analytics
[Attachment: acme-network-diagram.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Technical demo – Docs quickstart

Hi Evan – thanks for reaching out and for the context. Happy to set up a technical deep dive focused on Private deployments and performance/cost tradeoffs.

Proposed times (all PDT):
- Tue 2026-04-06 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2026-04-07 13:00–14:00

If neither works, send a couple slots that do and I can coordinate. I'll loop in Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer) to join the technical portion. Could you confirm whether you want a walkthrough of the private control plane or an on-prem install demo (we can tailor the deck)?

I've attached our short demo deck to give the team a preview. You can also self-book here if easier: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/technical-demo

Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@acme-analytics.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Apr 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Technical demo – Docs quickstart

Hi Marissa – thanks, appreciate the quick response. Heads up: the engineering lead who should attend has a conflict next week. Can we move the session to the following week? Proposed: Tue 2026-04-13 at 11:00am PDT.

Also, please invite our principal engineer Maya Rao (maya.rao@acme-analytics.com) – she'll want to review networking and KMS details.

I attached a network diagram that might be helpful for the session.

Thanks,
Evan

Perfect – thanks for the update. 2026-04-13 11:00am PDT works for us. I've added Dev (solutions) and Connor from my team to the invite so we can cover both deployment and cost/benchmarking questions.

I'll send a calendar invite with the Zoom link and attach the demo deck. If there's anything specific you'd like Dev to prepare (e.g., current model sizes, expected token throughput), reply-all and we'll add it to the agenda.
